title: Make the Sniper exercise readable from launch through impact
context: The owner requested a longer killable laser column with death animation/audio, a slower larger TALON Quiver preview, a compact mortar HUD leaving the target visible, and maximum-range warnings for every weapon.
outcome: The live-fire column defaults to 14 enemies across a longer depth, with adjustable 5–32 length and explicit 0.2× range-target HP (0.05–1×). Main game HP stays unchanged. Death emits one shared cue and a small particle burst, then topples/sinks/shrinks and removes the body. Quiver gains a lab-only 1.8 m TALON preview over 6 seconds using the existing heavy sampler and a following spotting monitor. The TALON GLB is pinned to the existing missile-kit revision and uses the shared pool implementation, with flights retaining pool ownership. Mortar now has a compact top map, forward-up left radar, target-centered main POV, visible shell trace/height and ground debris/splash ring. TRACK reports effective weapon maximum and orange near-limit/too-close or red out-of-range labels; tracking can see excluded missile targets while lock/fire remain gated.
alternatives: Using the missile lock filter for TRACK hid precisely the out-of-range targets the warning needed to report. The HUD now explicitly observes outside the firing envelope.
Live-fire toughness is an explicit stage control; no global damage/health or shipped FX schema change.
evidence: npm run check, assets:check and build passed; release 73f26185
npm run test:browser: full source suite passed

node scripts/browser-test.mjs --dist --sniper passed: fodder and solid-core death, live death voice, animation/removal, 1340-triangle TALON/heavy preview and pool release, range warnings across eight weapons, mortar clear center/world splash, launch-time aim and draft isolation
